name: Invertonator
description: System-wide screen inversion that websites cannot see — the GNOME/Wayland backend of Invertonator-rs. Inverts every pixel inside the compositor, AFTER applications (and their web content) rendered, so the web layer cannot detect it. Super+I toggles; Super+F7 pierces a true-color hole into the window under the pointer; a hole manager lists every hole in the panel menu; fullscreen windows auto-hole while inversion is on (fullscreen video); AT-SPI2 media lock-on punches true-color rects at exactly the images/videos in the focused window while everything else stays inverted; a panel indicator shows the state. Companion to the Invertonator-rs X11 gamma-ramp binary.
